g.title: S6 independently admitted evidence Closure / result / usage / disclosure
ConsumeApplied / ConsumeReply Separate physical state and knowledge
SendCommitted / commit reply Abort race / retained holds
DispatchClaimed / handle delivery At most one application invocation
FinalGate / TransportEntry Pause / takeover / accepted old work
Separate evidence transitions No result-to-refund shortcut
Exact grant and operation binding No positive result from unknown
Guarded state preservation Real CAS / source / history / budget
Exclusive authority + affine handle One claim / one local send handle

path.aria-label: One claim / one local send handle

g.title: Use-time and retirement premises Gate proof is not a physical stop

path.aria-label: Gate proof is not a physical stop

g.title: Monotonic facts and conservation Result / closure / usage stay distinct
MANDATORY CORRESPONDENCE / exact selected closure + complete event inventory Scheme owns source/lifecycle semantics. Go reports cloud state. Rust enforces the reference ledger/broker boundaries.

Lost replies do not undo authoritative state. A claim does not prove submission, and a result does not close an old emitter. Each physical event must preserve the operation binding, state transition and safety invariant.

path.aria-label: MANDATORY CORRESPONDENCE / exact selected closure + complete event inventory Scheme owns source/lifecycle semantics. Go reports cloud state. Rust enforces the reference ledger/broker boundaries.

Lost replies do not undo authoritative state. A claim does not prove submission, and a result does not close an old emitter. Each physical event must preserve the operation binding, state transition and safety invariant.
ORIGINAL SEMANTICS / CURRENT AUTHORITY / GUARDED EXECUTION
